paragraphs.text: Hilario Zepeda Montaño participated in Meeting LZC-10-02 on 2010-03-20. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Meeting LZC-10-02 on 2010-03-20. Meeting LZC-10-02 occurred at Lázaro Cárdenas on 2010-03-20. A nightclub manager in contact with the reporting office stated that Zepeda, known as El Hormiga, met with other network figures in a private room at a Lázaro Cárdenas restaurant to discuss a rival crew that had begun charging fees on the port road. The manager overheard part of the conversation while arranging the room and reported that the rival crew was described as small and poorly armed.

Gilberto Tinoco Arzate participated in Meeting LZC-10-02 on 2010-03-20. Meeting LZC-10-02 transited Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza on 2010-03-20. Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The manager identified Tinoco, called El Grúa, as the second participant and stated that Tinoco argued for paying the rival crew rather than confronting it. The manager understood from the conversation that the final decision rested with Anzures, who was not present.

The reporting office assesses the manager as having limited and incidental access to this activity. The source did not provide the full identity of every participant and the gaps are noted here. This information has not been corroborated by a second independent source at the time of writing. The reporting office cannot exclude that other participants were present and not named. The manager stated that the room was booked under a produce company name and that the bill was paid in cash by a man the manager did not recognize. The manager has no further access to the participants and is not expected to report on them again unless they return to the venue.
